en: Hello, we need a repair visit on the {system} system on {field}. Please tell us your first free day and a price. The lines must be flushed by {flush_date}.
mt: Hallo, we hebben een reparatiebezoek nodig op het {system} systeem op {field}.

en: Hello, we plan {n_ha} kg of nitrogen per hectare for {field} ({crop}). Do you advise two or three doses? We have applied {n_done} kg per ha so far.
mt: Hallo, we zijn van plan {n_ha} kg stikstof per hectare voor {field} ({crop}). Adviseert u twee of drie doses?

en: Hello {operator}, we spread {kind} on {field} on {date}: {tonnes} tonnes, {n_ha} kg of nitrogen per hectare. Please keep clear of streams, wells and the boundary strip.
mt: Hallo, we verspreiden tonnen stikstof per hectare, blijf uit de buurt van beken, putten en de grensstrook.

en: So far fertiliser and manure have put on {col:fertplan.n_done} kg of nitrogen per hectare, which is {col:fertplan.n_share} of the plan. The plan check shows: {col:fertplan.state}. The nitrogen balance against what the crop removes is {col:fertplan.n_bal} kg per hectare.
mt: Tot nu toe hebben mest en mest {col:fertplan.n_done} kg stikstof per hectare toegevoegd, wat {col:fertplan.n_share} van het plan is.

en: We order {col:orders.qty_ordered} {col:orders.unit} of {col:orders.item} at {col:orders.price} per {col:orders.unit}. The order value is {col:orders.value}.
mt: We ordenen {col:orders.qty_ordered} {col:orders.unit} van {col:orders.item} bij {col:orders.price} per {col:orders.unit}.

en: Please deliver on {col:orders.promised}. Send the delivery note with the batch or lot number and the weight, and tell us before the delivery if you cannot keep the date. The status of the order is {col:orders.status}.
mt: Stuur de bezorgbrief met de partij of partijnummer en het gewicht, en vertel ons voor de levering als u de datum niet kunt houden.

en: This season the field has used seed worth {col:costha.seed_cost}, fertiliser worth {col:costha.fert_cost}, crop protection worth {col:costha.prot_cost} and other inputs worth {col:costha.other_cost}. The total is {col:costha.total_cost}, or {col:costha.cost_ha} per hectare.
mt: In dit seizoen heeft het veld zaden van {col:costha.seed_cost}, meststoffen van {col:costha.fert_cost}, gewasbescherming van {col:costha.prot_cost} en andere grondstoffen van {col:costha.other_cost} gebruikt.

en: The last run was on {col:irrsched.last_run}. The next turn is on {col:irrsched.next_due}, in {col:irrsched.days_to} days. The turn check shows: {col:irrsched.state}. Water due this week: {col:irrsched.m3_week} cubic metres.
mt: De laatste run was op {col:irrsched.last_run}. De volgende beurt is op {col:irrsched.next_due}, in {col:irrsched.days_to} dagen. De beurt check toont aan: {col:irrsched.state}.

en: The supervisor writes the hours run and any fault in the irrigation log the same day. The lines are flushed on {col:irrsched.flush_date}.
mt: De leidinggevende schrijft de uren en eventuele storingen in het irrigatielogboek op dezelfde dag op.

en: The licence check shows: {col:water.licence_state}, with {col:water.licence_days} days to go. The pump service is due on {col:water.pump_service} and the service check shows: {col:water.service_state}. Pump energy cost this season: {col:water.energy_cost}.
mt: De vergunningscontrole toont aan: {col:water.licence_state}, met {col:water.licence_days} dagen te gaan. De pompdienst is verlopen op {col:water.pump_service} en de servicekontrole toont aan: {col:water.service_state}.

en: Input: {col:quotes.item}. Quantity asked: {col:quotes.qty}. List price: {col:quotes.list_price}.
mt: Invoer: {col:quotes.item}. Vraag om hoeveelheid: {col:quotes.qty}.

en: {col:quotes.vendor} quoted {col:quotes.price} per unit with {col:quotes.transport} for transport, a landed price of {col:quotes.landed} and a total of {col:quotes.total}. The lead time is {col:quotes.lead_days} days and the quote is valid until {col:quotes.valid_until}.
mt: {col:quotes.vendor} geciteerd {col:quotes.price} per eenheid met {col:quotes.transport} voor vervoer, een landingsprijs van {col:quotes.landed} en een totaal van {col:quotes.total}.

en: The quote ranks number {col:quotes.rank}. The best landed price for this input is {col:quotes.best}. Choosing this quote instead of the best one costs {col:quotes.extra} more. The quote check shows: {col:quotes.state}.
mt: De bestelde prijs voor deze input is {col:quotes.best}. Het kiezen van deze offerte in plaats van de beste kost {col:quotes.extra} meer. De offertecontrole toont aan: {col:quotes.state}.

en: Product: {col:chem.item}. Batch: {col:chem.batch}. Hazard class: {col:chem.hazard}. Shelf: {col:chem.shelf}.
mt: Product: {col:chem.item}. Batch: {col:chem.batch}. Gevaarlijke klasse: {col:chem.hazard}.

en: The batch was received on {col:chem.received} and expires on {col:chem.expiry}, which is in {col:chem.days_to_expiry} days. The quantity in the store is {col:chem.qty} {col:chem.unit}, worth {col:chem.value}. The expiry check shows: {col:chem.state}.
mt: De partij werd ontvangen op {col:chem.received} en vervalt op {col:chem.expiry}, dat is in {col:chem.days_to_expiry} dagen. De hoeveelheid in de winkel is {col:chem.qty} {col:chem.unit}, waarde {col:chem.value}.

en: The storekeeper is {col:chem.keeper}. Expired products are kept apart and labelled, and are returned to the supplier or handed to an approved collector. They are never used and never poured away.
mt: De vervalde producten worden gescheiden bewaard en geëtiketteerd en worden teruggegeven aan de leverancier of aan een erkende verzamelaar.

en: Product: {col:apps.item}. Method: {col:apps.method}. Rate: {col:apps.rate} kg per hectare, {col:apps.qty} kg in all. This supplied {col:apps.n_kg} kg of nitrogen, {col:apps.p_kg} kg of P2O5 and {col:apps.k_kg} kg of K2O, which is {col:apps.n_ha} kg of nitrogen per hectare.
mt: Dit leverde {col:apps.n_kg} kg stikstof, {col:apps.p_kg} kg P2O5 en {col:apps.k_kg} kg K2O, wat {col:apps.n_ha} kg stikstof per hectare is.

en: The operator was {col:apps.operator}. The plan check shows: {col:apps.state}.
mt: De operator was {col:apps.operator}.

en: The price now is {col:items.price} per {col:items.unit}, against {col:items.prev_price} last season, a change of {col:items.change}. The price check shows: {col:items.state}.
mt: De prijs is nu {col:items.price} per {col:items.unit}, tegenover {col:items.prev_price} vorig seizoen, een verandering van {col:items.change}.

en: We bought {col:items.spend} of this input this season. We hold {col:items.stock_bal} {col:items.unit} in stock, worth {col:items.stock_value}. Each kilogram of nutrient costs {col:items.cost_nutrient}.
mt: We hebben {col:items.spend} gekocht van deze input dit seizoen. We hebben {col:items.stock_bal} {col:items.unit} op voorraad, ter waarde van {col:items.stock_value}.

en: The label requires {col:limits.withhold} days between the last spray and the harvest, at most {col:limits.max_sprays} sprays and a dose of no more than {col:limits.max_dose} per hectare. People may re-enter after {col:limits.reentry} hours.
mt: Het etiket vereist {col:limits.withhold} dagen tussen de laatste bespuiting en de oogst, maximaal {col:limits.max_sprays} bespuitingen en een dosis van maximaal {col:limits.max_dose} per hectare.

en: We have recorded {col:limits.sprays_used} sprays this season. The last spray was on {col:limits.last_use}, so the crop is safe to harvest from {col:limits.safe_from}. The harvest check shows: {col:limits.state}.
mt: We hebben deze seizoen {col:limits.sprays_used} sprays geregistreerd. De laatste spray was op {col:limits.last_use}, dus het gewas is veilig om te oogsten van {col:limits.safe_from}.
